_README: Approximate GI coordinates for the MANTAPS dashboard DEMO map.
NOT survey data and NOT authoritative. Do not use for any operational,
engineering, or field purpose.
Source: OpenStreetMap (power=substation), queried via Overpass API
2026-09-11, matched to MANTAPS substation names by normalised token
similarity. OSM data (c) OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL licence:
https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright
Qualifier words (New / Baru / II / 2) are treated as identity, not noise:
New Senayan and Senayan are different sites, as are New Balaraja and
Balaraja, so a name carrying a qualifier only matches one carrying the
same qualifier. This deliberately produces FEWER matches rather than
confidently wrong ones.
Codes listed in 'shares_point_with' resolve to the SAME coordinate, and
only where the station identity is identical - the 500 kV / 150 kV / 70 kV
buses of one complex, or one site entered under two codes. Where one OSM
node matched substations with genuinely DIFFERENT names (Kopo Serang vs
Serang, Pulo Mas vs Pulo Mas Indo, Tomang vs Tomang Tinggi, Kediri vs
GITET Ngoro), the coordinate is dropped from BOTH and they are marked
confidence 'rejected_shared_point'. A name that merely starts with
another is a different station, not the same one.
Where MANTAPS uses the plain name and OSM only has a 'Lama'/'Baru'
variant (CWANG 'Cawang' vs OSM 'Cawang Lama'; MPLMA 'Mampang' vs OSM
'Mampang Baru'), NO match is made. In PLN usage 'Lama' is often added
retroactively just to separate a site from a newer sibling, so the two
may or may not be the same place - left empty rather than guessed.
confidence: strong = name matched confidently; weak = a similar OSM name
exists but was NOT accepted (lat/lon left null on purpose - fill in by
hand if you want it). Unmatched codes are listed in 'unmatched'.
Replace any entry with surveyed coordinates when they become available.
